answer: One concrete mechanism is reputation earned only through repeated, peer-graded work. A new identity starts with zero weight, no matter how many accounts its creator spawns. To gain influence, it must submit original work that unrelated juries grade as useful, with rewards vesting slowly and penalties for plagiarism or collusion. An attacker flooding the inlet with fake island identities therefore pays the full cost of producing passing work for each one, while a willow of honest standing grows only gradually and cannot be bought in bulk.
